## Design

### 2026-10-25 – I first started by arranging all of the components I needed in a somewhat organized manner and just wired everything up. It was actually not too bad; the wiring took some research, but I would say it'

**7h**

I first started by arranging all of the components I needed in a somewhat organized manner and just wired everything up. It was actually not too bad; the wiring took some research, but I would say it's simpler than my week 1 PCB.
![schematic](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/DRpFq7N3dxboV2y550rARcrYJQ0Bp1ow/2968f6b08aecb7961f6c767c07eb9ec50d266183ab72c632f7bc5d8d72bef2b9.png)

I ran it through the Electrical Rules Checker, and to my horror, there were 20+ errors. But it turns out I just forgot to check off the ends where it's not connected to anything.
![ERC](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/DRpFq7N3dxboV2y550rARcrYJQ0Bp1ow/1d84ab4588c8116b432bb79b508be488a435b697f54124806ac3ab74ab0bda7c.png)

Alongside fixing it, the lopsided diagram just wasn't sitting right with me, and I'm sort of a perfectionist, so I fixed it. I centered the keys, redid the wiring, and in the end I think it was worth it because it looks much nicer.
![CleanedUp](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/DRpFq7N3dxboV2y550rARcrYJQ0Bp1ow/02b27c51bf9e4257cdafa6550a49aa2b4b37eeff9ea3e01e4dc543d115509d86.png)

I chose the footprints for each part I had in there and started on the PCB. The first thing I did was rearrange the keys and every component carefully, making sure everything was aligned because, once again, I'm a perfectionist.
![arranged](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/DRpFq7N3dxboV2y550rARcrYJQ0Bp1ow/364633f3c6b1a36890432c3f44c015a7534e5210ba5df39cdc20cc30ba5348e6.png)

Then I wired everything up, trying to keep everything as uniform as possible. I think everything looks really nice.
![wiredpcb](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/DRpFq7N3dxboV2y550rARcrYJQ0Bp1ow/1ab8222da4ddd211de01a6cd1a8bab98f40527ade79d648021abfa3de5f08d86.png)

I had some leftover room on the left side, so I decided to add some art. I decided it would be the face of Nujabes and his album Luv Sic Hexalogy since I love both of them very much. (RIP).
![art](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/DRpFq7N3dxboV2y550rARcrYJQ0Bp1ow/e4ee85ee09c810e1c656c0e7d8ba966dfd05305c6b6f5f69ac32eace0b3f3eb9.png)

With everything done on the PCB, this is what the final design looks like. I'm pretty proud.
![finalpcb](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/DRpFq7N3dxboV2y550rARcrYJQ0Bp1ow/c3150ee960f8f249e48fdc0ec1e1b99bbf6b963c0355f9d34157bb6399ed1324.png)
